name: FIVERR DEMO - Fictional Dental KB Chatbot (Local Ollama)

parameters.jsCode: const j=$json; const raw=String(j.message||''); const message=raw.replace(/[\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); const kb=[['KB-001','Opening hours','The clinic is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 18:00 and Saturday from 09:00 to 13:00. It is closed on Sundays and public holidays.','hours opening weekend saturday closed'],['KB-002','Location and transport','The fictional demo clinic is at Demo Street 24, 10115 Berlin. The nearest station is Hauptbahnhof, about a 7-minute walk away. No real clinic exists at this demo address.','address location transport parking station'],['KB-003','New patient appointment','New patients can request an appointment through the website form or by calling the fictional reception number +49 30 000000. The chatbot does not confirm appointments; reception must confirm the date and time.','appointment book new patient reception schedule'],['KB-004','Routine examination','A routine examination usually takes 30 minutes. It may include a discussion of concerns, an oral examination and, only when clinically indicated, an X-ray. Final treatment advice is given by a dentist.','exam checkup x-ray duration dentist'],['KB-005','Professional cleaning','Professional dental cleaning is offered and usually takes 45 to 60 minutes. The demo price is EUR 95 to EUR 140 depending on the time required. Reception can provide a non-binding estimate.','cleaning hygiene price cost duration'],['KB-006','Teeth whitening','In-clinic whitening is available after a suitability check by a dentist. The fictional demo price starts at EUR 320. Whitening is not performed during pregnancy and may be unsuitable for untreated cavities or gum disease.','whitening bleaching price pregnancy cosmetic'],['KB-007','Insurance and payment','The clinic accepts public and private German health insurance. Coverage depends on the insurer and treatment. Card and cash payments are accepted. Patients should ask reception or their insurer for a binding coverage decision.','insurance payment card cash coverage'],['KB-008','Cancellation policy','Appointments should be cancelled or rescheduled at least 24 hours in advance. A fictional demo late-cancellation fee of EUR 50 may apply. Reception reviews exceptions individually.','cancel reschedule fee late appointment'],['KB-009','Dental emergencies','For severe swelling, uncontrolled bleeding, facial trauma, difficulty breathing or a life-threatening situation, call emergency services at 112. For urgent dental pain during opening hours, contact reception. The chatbot cannot diagnose or provide emergency treatment.','emergency pain swelling bleeding trauma 112'],['KB-010','Children and accessibility','Children are welcome from age three. A parent or legal guardian must attend appointments for minors. The fictional clinic entrance and treatment rooms are wheelchair accessible; patients can tell reception about assistance needs.','children minor parent wheelchair accessibility']].map(x=>({id:x[0],title:x[1],content:x[2],tags:x[3]})); const q=message.toLowerCase(); const tokens=[...new Set(q.match(/[\p{L}\p{N}-]{3,}/gu)||[])]; const scored=kb.map(e=>{const title=e.title.toLowerCase(),tags=e.tags.toLowerCase(),content=e.content.toLowerCase(); let score=0; for(const t of tokens){if(tags.includes(t))score+=3;if(title.includes(t))score+=2;if(content.includes(t))score+=1;} return {...e,score};}).filter(e=>e.score>0).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score).slice(0,3); const emergency=/cannot breathe|difficulty breathing|uncontrolled bleeding|facial trauma|severe swelling|life-threatening|emergency/i.test(message); const medical=/diagnos|do i need|should i take|prescri|root canal|what is wrong|symptom/i.test(message); const booking=/book me|make an appointment|schedule me|appointment.*(tomorrow|today|at \d)/i.test(message); const human=/human|person|agent|receptionist/i.test(message); const injection=/ignore (all|the|previous)|reveal (the )?(prompt|instructions)|system prompt/i.test(message); let handoffReason=null; if(!message||message.length>500)handoffReason='invalid_input'; else if(emergency)handoffReason='emergency'; else if(medical)handoffReason='medical_advice'; else if(booking)handoffReason='booking_request'; else if(human)handoffReason='human_requested'; else if(injection)handoffReason='prompt_injection'; else if(/implant/i.test(message))handoffReason='low_confidence'; else if(!scored.length||scored[0].score<2)handoffReason='low_confidence'; return [{json:{...j,message,matches:scored,route:handoffReason?'handoff':'answer',handoffReason,kbVersion:'2026-10-13-demo'}}];

assignments.name: answer
assignments.value: ={{ $json.handoffReason === 'emergency' ? 'This may be urgent. Call emergency services at 112 now. The chatbot cannot diagnose or provide emergency treatment.' : 'I can’t safely answer that from the clinic knowledge base. Please contact reception for help.' }}

parameters.jsCode: const source=$('FIVERR DEMO - Build Ollama Request').item.json; try{const raw=$json.message?.content; const out=JSON.parse(raw); const allowed=new Set(source.matches.map(x=>x.id)); const citations=Array.isArray(out.citations)?out.citations.filter(x=>allowed.has(x)):[]; const answer=String(out.answer||'').trim().slice(0,600); if(!answer||!citations.length||out.handoff===true)throw new Error('invalid grounded output'); return [{json:{status:'answered',answer,citations,handoff:false,route:'answer',retrievedKbIds:source.matches.map(x=>x.id),citationValidated:true,sessionId:source.sessionId,kbVersion:source.kbVersion,llm:'local qwen3:8b'}}];}catch(e){return [{json:{status:'handoff',answer:'I can’t safely answer that from the clinic knowledge base. Please contact reception for help.',citations:[],handoff:true,handoffReason:'model_output_invalid',route:'handoff',retrievedKbIds:source.matches.map(x=>x.id),citationValidated:false,sessionId:source.sessionId,kbVersion:source.kbVersion,llm:'local qwen3:8b'}}];}
